The '''Ancient Pig''' was an [[NPC]] in the {{Zone|Hub}} that was summoned when all 7 {{Item|Shiny Relic}}s were found. The shrine for the '''Ancient Pig''' could be found in the {{Zone|Hub}} after {{NPC|Technoblade}} became mayor, as it was his second perk.

When a {{Item|Shiny Relic}} was found it automatically went and hovered by the [[Blood God Shrine]] and gave a copy of the relic to the player who found it. When all seven were collected, it summoned the '''Ancient Pig''', giving various special buffs to players.

Upon the player's first click on the '''Ancient Pig''', it started dialogue and opened a menu granting a {{Item|Flying Pig}}.

== Ancient Pig Effects ==
After the 7 {{Item|Shiny Relic}}s were found, the '''Ancient Pig''' spawned, floating over the [[Blood God Shrine]]. The '''Ancient Pig''' granted a game-wide effect every [[SkyBlock Day]] to players, for two real-life days time. Effects could be repeated, indicating that the effect selection was at mostly random.

When a new effect was selected, a full-screen message appeared for all players alerting them that a new effect was being selected. This was followed by a random-wheel like selection of the next effect. Once it was selected, a chat alert was sent out, notifying all players.
